$comment: Approved session models for the Foreman Line, as data rather than code.
A TOP-LEVEL session runs exactly one role at a time and its model is a
session-launch property, so this gate checks membership, not role binding:
the running model must be one of the models some role is allowed to use.
Per-role binding at DISPATCH time is routing-policy.yaml's job, not this
file's - see plugins/foreman-line/routing-policy/routing-policy.yaml.
Matching is BYTE-EXACT (D69(b) ruling (ii)). That is what makes
'claude-opus-5-5[1m]' fail without needing a variant rule: it simply is not
this list. The oneMillionContext block below exists only to give that
specific, recurring case a message a human can act on.
Ids are the Pi provider-local spelling with DASHES (Amendment 06 N1).
The bare id is what a SessionStart payload reports, so that is what is
matched here; the launch hint shows the full 'anthropic/<id>' form that
'pi --model' takes. OpenRouter's dotted slugs are a DIFFERENT namespace and
never appear in this file.
COVERAGE LIMIT (Amendment 06 N2, residual MODEL_GATE_HOOK_COVERAGE):
this gate observes Claude-Code-hosted sessions only, because it is driven by
SessionStart/PreToolUse. A session launched as a bare 'pi' subprocess fires
neither event and is NOT gated. Do not read a pass here as whole-fleet
coverage.

oneMillionContext.$comment: Substrings that identify a 1M-context variant, for a better message only. Rejection already follows from byte-exact matching.
oneMillionContext.message: A 1M-context session holds no coordinator authority (D69(b) ruling (ii)) and must stop rather than proceed.
